parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and designed to fit snugly on top of the pot.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, and it can be lifted to check or stir the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted off or placed onto the pot; it does not move independently when in place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape, and designed to hold food or liquid for cooking.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for cooking, heating, or boiling food and liquids, often placed on a stove or heating element.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or moved by its handles when necessary.
